_comment: What each special day does, and the stone that starts it. Days last about six hours and either turn up at the start of a game day or are summoned by a player with a stone. Stone names must match the item name the bots use. Edit freely.

Day of Joule.what: Manufacturing and potion food costs are halved. Failed mixes still cost the normal amount.

Day of Mana.what: Mana potions give 50% more. Mana 7 instead of 5, Spirit Restoration 30 instead of 20, Extra Mana 75 instead of 50.

Day of Mushrooms.what: Toadstools are safer to eat, though poison still applies.

Day of No Grief.what: Weapons, armour and clothes do not break in combat.

Day of Positivity.what: Harvester of Sorrows, I can't dance, Power Hungry and Hellspawn all stop working.

Day of the Print.what: Reading a book may grant its knowledge instantly.

Day of Recycling.what: 5% chance of keeping your ingredients when mixing.

Day of Bones.what: Everyone can eat bones, and some creatures drop more of them.

Healing Day.what: 5 health restored every minute whatever your food level.

Increased rare manufacturing day.what: Better chance of a rare result when making items.

Non Stop Day.what: Harvesting does not stop for mini harvesting events.

Day of Evanescence.what: Everyone has the Evanescence perk, monsters included.

Reconstruction Day.what: Used items have a chance to stay in your inventory.

Scholars Day.what: Every skill gets a random experience bonus, roughly +1% to +42%.

Scientists Day.what: No book knowledge needed for harvesting, manufacturing, alchemy and the rest. You still need the nexus.

Acid Rain Day.what: Worn items may be destroyed in the rain. Indoors, caves and Desert Pines are safe.

Day of Fasting.what: No eating. At 0 hunger, research, mixing and regeneration all stop. Creature food still works.

Day of Murphy.what: Every failure is critical, so ingredients are lost.

Day of the Brave.what: No fleeing, even with disengagement rings.

Labour Day.what: No manufacturing, or anything else using the mix window.

Solar Flares Day.what: Outdoors in daylight costs 2 health a minute. Isla Prima is unaffected.

Day of Invasions.what: Invasions are more likely, last longer and are harder.

Day of Stronger Animals and Monsters.what: Respawning animals and monsters hit harder and give more experience. Invasion and instance mobs are unchanged.

Day of the Dead.what: Anything that dies may respawn on the spot at full health, dropping nothing.

Increased Harvesting Events Day.what: Random harvesting events are more common.

Decreased Rare Manufacturing day.what: Worse chance of a rare result when making items.

Leonard's Day.what: Leonard is stronger, stays awake all day, and is easier to find and kill.

No Drops Day.what: Nothing drops when players or AI die. Rostogol stones still go.

Peace Day.what: No fighting at all, and Remote Heal does not work. Ants can still fight.

Day of More Grief.what: Items are more likely to break.
